name: mdcat
description: mdcat — Markdown renderer for the terminal. Renders Markdown files with syntax highlighting, tables, links. Cat for markdown.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/swsnr/mdcat/releases/download/mdcat-2.7.1/mdcat-2.7.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz && tar xzf mdcat-2.7.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz && sudo mv mdcat /usr/local/bin/ && rm mdcat-2.7.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz

commands.description: mdcat — Markdown renderer for the terminal. Renders Markdown files with syntax highlighting, tables, links. Cat for markdown.
